_comment: Spoken-only pronunciation fixes. Key = word as written (case-insensitive, whole word). Value = a pronunciation hint like "thee-ah-cast" (Kokoro gets it joined, "Theeahcast"; the LTX presenter gets "Thee-ah-cast"), or {"tts": "...", "presenter": "..."} to set each engine explicitly. Captions/on-screen text keep the original spelling. Per-video overrides come from the chat ("X is pronounced Y"). Verified by ear 2026-10-09: TheiaCast is "THEE-uh-cast" (Theia, the Greek Titaness) — Kokoro: "Theea cast"; LTX presenter: "Thee-ah-cast"; VoxCPM2 (not wired in yet): "Theea cast" when cloning bf_alice, "Thia-cast" with its default voice. 2026-10-10: VoxCPM2 varies per take, so lines are transcribed and re-recorded (assets.js speakChecked). 'tts' lists alternatives tried in order on re-takes; 'heard' = how a right take transcribes (the approved clone take: "TheaCast"), 'notHeard' = known-wrong transcriptions ("theeacast" = a literal thee-ee-ay, reported at the end of conv 210).
